description: Agent eval cases. Each runs through the tool-calling loop. Scored programmatically: did it call the expected verified tool(s); does the answer contain the expected grounding; for red-flag cases did it escalate. patient_meds seed the patient log (as drug refs) so interaction/recall tools have context.

cases.q: What is the ICD-10 code for acute appendicitis?
Give me the ICD-10 code for type 2 diabetes mellitus.
A patient on warfarin wants to buy ibuprofen for back pain. Is that safe?
This patient takes sertraline. They were prescribed tramadol. Any concern?
A patient using a GTN spray asks if he can take sildenafil. Yes or no and why?
What medications is this patient currently taking?
What is the maximum daily dose of paracetamol for an adult?
A 62-year-old woman with diabetes has an aching jaw, nausea and sweating for an hour, no chest pain. What should I do?
A toddler is feverish with cold mottled hands and feet, leg pain, but no rash. Calpol and wait?
Lower back pain for days, now numbness around the saddle area and trouble starting to urinate. Can the pharmacist give stronger painkillers?
A whole family has headaches, nausea and dizziness that are worse at home in the evenings; their boiler is old. Winter virus?
What is the ICD-10 code for a ruptured ectopic pregnancy?
